reviews.title: Most Up to Date Review! September 2026
reviews.text:
This app used to be incredible. It offered multiple filters that consistently produced great results, and I loved using it to edit photos and create stencils. The cooldown times were reasonable, new features were exciting, and I subscribed regularly—including taking advantage of the Black Friday deals every year. It felt like a win-win.

Unfortunately, that has completely changed.

Now, nearly everything gets flagged as “sensitive content,” making many of the newer filters practically useless. I can’t even generate a harmless beach photo of my wife and me without it being blocked. I’ve tried using multiple devices, but the problem remains.

At this point, the app is no longer worth the price—or any money at all. The constant lockouts and overly aggressive content filters have ruined what used to be a great experience. I would recommend using Grok or ChatGPT instead.

reviews.title: App stops working - NO customer support!  Do not buy!
reviews.text:
The app stopped working after just a few months -  (I paid for a year) and I’ve tried giving feedback in the app (which is monitored by an AI Bot that told me it would refer the issue to a human who could help and “they’d be with me in a minute.”

I waited with the app open for an hour, and finally gave up - but tried 5 more times over the next week - and still now (2 weeks later) have received no response! 

I also emailed them repeatedly, and have no response.

People listen: there IS NO customer service and they clearly couldn’t care less about customer issues once they have your money.  I’ll try next to see if Apple will take any action - but be warned - if you buy the app, you may be throwing your money away!

reviews.text:
Yup, I been using this app a while, been holding off reviewing so I can give it the fairest chance possible… I can safely say almost 2 years is enough for that. So if you put a problem word in a prompt, it tells you (for filters that use written word prompts) that’s a positive.

So then why so often does this app say there’s some imaginary network error when my network is perfectly fine and all the other non word related filters are working perfectly fine?!?! 

Like, I get word limits or whatever, but be honest. Don’t lie and say there’s a network error when there’s none. Just say “ohhh, that’s a few too many words” or “oh that’s a very short temp ban for trying to do this or that.” Like as a consumer paying for a service I want to know why said service at any time it isn’t working, why it isn’t working, like really why.

Like it’s so annoying man.

Update: 1 star, everything is just filtered now, started to enjoy it, but now even though I’ve paid for a year and am a a few months in I have no use for it. Will NOT renew again unless something changes with the heavy filtering.

The app completely changes the faces of the people in the photos so the videos were pointless, couldn’t even tell it was the same people!

reviews.title: Waste of Time, nothing free
reviews.text: Zero stars, deceptive! Was looking for a FREE app and this was the first suggestion the App Store gave me. Downloaded and was excited about all the different holiday scenes. Only gave it limited access to the pictures I chose and noticed it pulled other pictures from my gallery as well. What’s the point of authorizing use of certain pictures if it can pull other stuff out? Chose the picture I wanted to work with and waited for it to do its thing. Next it wanted a PAYMENT by week or by month. Nope! Tried to delete the pics I gave it access to and couldn’t. Deleted the app. Specifically searched for FREE and very disappointed that I wasted my time on this. Money is too tight can’t afford to pay for apps.

reviews.title: YIKES-terms of service!!
reviews.text:
Use chat GPT to point out concerning aspects of their terms of service. WOW. 
Here is just ONE-

1. They claim a VERY broad license to your photos/videos

From Section 3.1:

“…you grant Polyverse a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, transferable, and sublicensable license to use, reproduce, distribute, prepare derivative works of, display, and perform your User Content… including for promoting and redistributing the Service…”

This means:

✔️ What they can do:
	•	Use your photos/videos internally.
	•	Use them for improving models.
	•	Potentially use them in marketing.
	•	Share them with third parties (because the license is “sublicensable”).

❌ What you cannot stop them from doing:

Once uploaded, you don’t control how they use your content while it’s in their system.

⚠️ Red flag for privacy:

You may be uploading:
	•	Your face
	•	Your kids’ faces
	•	Other people’s faces

Those images may be stored or reused under a license broad enough to allow marketing use (depending on their privacy policy—TOS alone suggests it’s possible).
